newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway oil body confirms Esso/Enterprise find.
newsitem.headline: Norway oil body confirms Esso/Enterprise find.

text.p: The Norwegian Oil Directorate (OD) confirmed on Tuesday that Esso Norge had made an oil and gas discovery in block 25/10 in the North Sea, 15 km southwest of the Balder field.

Drilled to a depth of 2,628 below sea level, the well tested at a rate of 672 cubic metres of oil per day and 77,600 cubic metres of gas per day, through a 16 millimetre choke, the OD said in a statement.
"The Oil Directorate considers the results of the drilling as interesting for further exploration in the area," a statement said.
Earlier on Tuesday the daily Stavanger Aftenbladet said testing of the tentatively-known Hanz find had been so positive that the Deepsea Trym rig had already begun a side-track well.
The newspaper said the side-track well could indicate the prospect held up to 200 million barrels, in the same class as the Jotun discovery.
Esso is operator of exploration 028P with a 50 percent stake and is partnered by Enterprise Oil Norge.
